map.某公司期末应付账款 200 万元，年度营业成本 2400 万元，DPO=200÷: A company has ending accounts payable of 200 (10k CNY) and annual cost of goods sold of 2400 (10k CNY), so DPO = 200 ÷ (2400/365) = 200 ÷ 6.575 ≈ 30.4 days - on average it pays suppliers every 30 days.
map.DPO 越长越好吗？: Is a longer DPO always better?
map.适当长可占用无息资金、改善现金周期，但过长会损害供应商关系、可能影响供货与折扣，: Moderately long lets the company use interest-free funds and improves the cash cycle, but too long damages supplier relationships and may affect supply and discounts, so balance bargaining power against creditworthiness.
map.DPO 与现金周期的关系？: How does DPO relate to the cash cycle?
map.现金周期=DSO+DIH−DPO，DPO 是其中唯一减项，延长付款天数能缩短企业: Cash cycle = DSO + DIH − DPO; DPO is the only subtraction, so extending payment days shortens the time the company's own cash is tied up.
